title: OwnershipDeclaration
description: Section-ownership declaration for a control surface (ADR-0.35.0 § Decision item 4). Mirrors gzkit.content.ownership.OwnershipDeclaration. Every H1/H2 section of the declared surface MUST have exactly one entry in `sections` -- there is no undeclared third state (REQ-0.35.0-04-01).

sections.description: Section id (stable kebab-case, keyed on id never on heading title -- REQ-0.35.0-04-06) mapped to its ownership state.

unowned_byte_floor.description: Decrease-only ratchet floor: the summed byte span of the sections declared 'unowned'.

measured_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the declaration's byte spans were measured. Illustrative provenance only -- coverage and spans are re-derived at run time, never trusted from this field (governance-core.md).

floor_event_id.description: The ledger event id that last set unowned_byte_floor -- an unowned_ratchet_updated or section_ownership_unowned event whose new_unowned_byte_floor must equal this declaration's stored floor. Null ONLY for a genesis declaration, permitted solely when the stored floor equals the summed byte span of the sections declared 'unowned' (REQ-0.35.0-04-02). A direct hand-edit of unowned_byte_floor with no matching attested transition fails closed on load.
